prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: Daggerfall Unity pixel-art NPC eye atlas, exact reference-grid edit.
Input image: Image 1 is the only edit target and sole reference: eyes-reference-grid.png, a 2×2 grid of the same upper 64×35 portrait half enlarged 8×. It is row-major: open, half closed, closed, repeated open.
Primary request: Return one 1024×560 image containing the same exact 2×2 grid and cell boundaries. Change only eyes, eyelids, brows, and stationary orbital creases to show one consistent angry expression across all four phases. Keep all other pixels and face framing aligned to the reference.
Style: original softly blended pixel art on a true native pixel grid, nearest-neighbor 8× enlargement; no smooth vector shapes or circles.
Expression and phases: clearly angry, tense brows with lowered inner ends and original brow thickness, never heavy or near-black. Keep both eyes’ spacing, gaze, gray-violet iris width, pupil location, glint position and shape consistent across open, half-closed, closed, and repeated open cells. Lids cover vertically only; they do not move the glints down, shrink or round the irises, shift gaze, or cross the lower lids. Closed cell fully conceals iris and sclera. Keep same angry brows and stationary creases in every cell.
Palette: preserve source muted warm tan skin, olive-brown eye shadows, gray-violet irises, soft pixel-art contrast. No orange skin, lipstick red, white flashes, or new colors.
Constraints: eye reference grid only. Do not add text, borders, labels, watermark, new facial features, or change nose, mouth, cheeks, hair, neck, clothing, background, head shape, lighting, or any non-eye pixels. Full grid content, exact aspect, alignment, and all four correctly ordered cells are required.
